t: You're on Bunhill Row, a street in St Luke's, in the London Borough of Islington. It runs north to south between Old Street and Chiswell Street. On the east side you'll see the burial ground of Bunhill Fields, and beside it the open space of the Honourable Artillery Company's Artillery Ground. Alfred Tylor, an English geologist, was born on this street in 1824. He died in 1884.
